rules.rule: CORE_EVIDENCE (verifier results, final reports, SHA256, governance JSONs): PERMANENT — never auto-deleted
PHASE_ARTIFACTS (reports, ledgers, decisions): PROJECT_LIFETIME — deleted only with project
CACHE (old snapshots, intermediates): PRUNABLE — user can prune, default keep last 5 phases
STALE (retired/superseded): RETIRE_OR_PRUNE — user can retire or prune after confirmation
DUPLICATE (same evidence, lower tier): DEDUP — keep highest sourceTier, remove lower
FROZEN projects: all categories preserved, no auto-cleanup, no default mount
ARCHIVED projects: CORE_EVIDENCE preserved, CACHE pruned, no mount
DELETE: requires 2-step confirmation (PLAN → review → CONFIRM). CORE_EVIDENCE deletable only with explicit --force-evidence flag
